Recovery of loans: ₹100 crore
Revenue expenditure: ₹1,930 crore
Disinvestment proceeds: ₹10 crore
Interest payments: ₹380 crore
Revenue receipts: ₹1,150 crore
Capital expenditure: ₹900 crore
items.answer: (i) RD = ₹780 crore; (ii) FD = ₹1,570 crore; (iii) PD = ₹1,190 crore
items.markingKey: (i) RD = RE − RR = 1930 − 1150 = 780; (ii) FD = total expenditure − (RR + recovery of loans + disinvestment) = (1930 + 900) − (1150 + 100 + 10) = 1570; (iii) PD = FD − interest = 1570 − 380 = 1190 (1 mark each).
